-- Edited by Harbinger451
-- StartsBy: Script
-- Questee: anyone with a spade
Quest: GraveRobbingQuestWeak
DisplayName: Grave Robbing!
-- Message panels
QRC:

Message:  1013
<ce> You spend some time digging up a grave, but
<ce> you were unable to find anything of value!

Message:  1014
<ce> You spend some time digging up a grave and
<ce> you were able to find some _loot1_!

Message:  1015
<ce> You spend some time digging up a grave and
<ce> you were able to find some _loot1_
<ce> and a _loot2_!

Message:  1016
<ce> You spend some time digging up a grave and
<ce> you were able to find some _loot1_,
<ce> a _loot2_ and some _loot3_!

Message:  1017
<ce> You spend some time digging up a grave and
<ce> you were able to find some _loot1_,
<ce> a _loot2_, some _loot3_,
<ce> and a _loot4_!

Message:  1024
<ce> While robbing the grave, you
<ce> discovered a _weapon_
<ce> that must be worth some decent coin.

Message:  1025
<ce> While robbing the grave, you
<ce> discovered a _armor_
<ce> that must be worth some decent coin.

Message:  1026
<ce> While robbing the grave, you
<ce> discovered a _magic_
<ce> that must be worth some decent coin.

Message:  1027
<ce> While robbing the grave, you
<ce> discovered a _potion_
<ce> that must be worth some decent coin.

Message:  1030
<ce> While robbing the grave, you
<ce> discovered a copy of the book
<ce> _book_
<ce> that must be worth some decent coin.

Message:  1033
<ce> While robbing the grave, you
<ce> discovered the body within was fresh
<ce> and would be a fine subject for Necromancy.

Message:  1034
<ce> While robbing the grave, you
<ce> discovered a _mensclothing_
<ce> that might be worth some coin.

Message:  1035
<ce> While robbing the grave, you
<ce> discovered a _womensclothing_
<ce> that might be worth some coin.

Message:  1036
<ce> Your Grave Robbing has disturbed the dead!


QBN:

Item _loot1_ skin
Item _loot2_ religious
Item _loot3_ organs
Item _loot4_ trinket
Item _weapon_ weapon
Item _armor_ armor
Item _magic_ magic_item
Item _potion_ potion
Item _book_ book
Item _body_ dead_body
Item _mensclothing_ mens_clothing
Item _womensclothing_ womens_clothing

Foe _ghost_ is Ghost
Foe _wraith_ is Wraith


-- Quest start-up:
	reduce player fatigue by 30
	raise time by 2:00
	pick one of _0loot_ _1loot_ _1loot_ _2loot_ _3loot_ _4loot_


_weakluc_ task:
	when attribute Luck is at least 0

_evenluc_ task:
	when attribute Luck is at least 40

_strongluc_ task:
	when attribute Luck is at least 60

_verystrongluc_ task:
	when attribute Luck is at least 80

_worstchanceluc_ task:
	when _weakluc_ and not _evenluc_

_evenchanceluc_ task:
	when _evenluc_ and not _strongluc_

_goodchanceluc_ task:
	when _strongluc_ and not _verystrongluc_

_bestchanceluc_ task:
	when _verystrongluc_

variable _0loot_ 

_foundnothing_ task:
	when _0loot_ and _0bonus_
	say 1013

_1loot_ task:
	say 1014
	get item _loot1_
	make _loot1_ permanent

_2loot_ task:
	say 1015
	get item _loot1_
	make _loot1_ permanent
	get item _loot2_
	make _loot2_ permanent

_3loot_ task:
	say 1016
	get item _loot1_
	make _loot1_ permanent
	get item _loot2_
	make _loot2_ permanent
	get item _loot3_
	make _loot3_ permanent

_4loot_ task:
	say 1017
	get item _loot1_
	make _loot1_ permanent
	get item _loot2_
	make _loot2_ permanent
	get item _loot3_
	make _loot3_ permanent
	get item _loot4_
	make _loot4_ permanent

_looted_ task:
	when _0loot_ or _1loot_ or _2loot_ or _3loot_ or _4loot_
	pick one of _disturb_ _notdisturb_ _notdisturb_ _notdisturb_ _notdisturb_

_disturb_ task:
	pick one of _ghostdisturbed_ _ghostdisturbed_ _ghostdisturbed_ _wraithdisturbed_

_ghostdisturbed_ task:
	say 1036
	create foe _ghost_ every 0 minutes 1 times with 100% success

_wraithdisturbed_ task:
	say 1036
	create foe _wraith_ every 0 minutes 1 times with 100% success

variable _notdisturb_

_bonusweak_ task:
	when _looted_ and _worstchanceluc_
	pick one of _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _1bonus_

_bonuseven_ task:
	when _looted_ and _evenchanceluc_
	pick one of _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _1bonus_ _1bonus_

_bonusgood_ task:
	when _looted_ and _goodchanceluc_
	pick one of _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _1bonus_ _1bonus_ _1bonus_

_bonusbest_ task:
	when _looted_ and _bestchanceluc_
	pick one of _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _1bonus_ _1bonus_ _1bonus_ _1bonus_

_0bonus_ task:
	end quest

_1bonus_ task:
	pick one of _weaponitem_ _armoritem_ _magicitem_ _potionitem_ _bookitem_ _bodyitem_ _mensitem_ _womensitem_

_weaponitem_ task:
	update-quest-item _weapon_ Leveled
	say 1024
	get item _weapon_
	make _weapon_ permanent
	end quest

_armoritem_ task:
	update-quest-item _armor_ Leveled
	say 1025
	get item _armor_
	make _armor_ permanent
	end quest

_magicitem_ task:
	say 1026
	get item _magic_
	make _magic_ permanent
	end quest

_potionitem_ task:
	say 1027
	get item _potion_
	make _potion_ permanent
	end quest

_bookitem_ task:
	say 1030
	get item _book_
	make _book_ permanent
	end quest

_bodyitem_ task:
	say 1033
	get item _body_
	make _body_ permanent
	end quest

_mensitem_ task:
	say 1034
	get item _mensclothing_
	make _mensclothing_ permanent
	end quest

_womensitem_ task:
	say 1035
	get item _womensclothing_
	make _womensclothing_ permanent
	end quest
